sources.title: HGNC identifiers
sources.note: Approved symbols, aliases, stable IDs, names and OMIM gene identifiers. Retrieved 2026-11-01.

sources.title: ClinGen gene–disease validity
sources.note: All assertion rows retained with disease, MOI, classification, expert panel and evaluation date.

sources.title: ClinGen dosage sensitivity
sources.note: Gene records only. Regions remain separate. %HI is the DECIPHER HI percentile rank (lower indicates greater predicted HI), not a probability.

sources.title: GeneBayes s_het · Spence et al.
sources.note: Supplementary Table 1: post_mean and 95% posterior credible interval. Evolutionary selection against heterozygous loss of function; not an HI probability.

sources.title: Collins et al. · Cell 2022
sources.note: Table S7: pHaplo is the predicted probability of haploinsufficiency (0–1); pTriplo is probability of triplosensitivity. Higher pHaplo means greater predicted HI.

sources.title: D&D targeting and variant snapshot
sources.note: Gene-level targeting counts and local pathogenic/likely pathogenic (P/LP) counts. Duplicate disease rows are not summed. Dominant P/LP counts retain source annotation; variant-level dominant assignments are not supplied.

sources.title: Legacy ClinVar–OMIM dominant counts
sources.note: Original dominant_mutation_count retained separately; source snapshot date and per-variant inclusion rules are unavailable. Do not combine with the D&D workbook dominant P/LP count.

sources.title: ClinVar gene summary
sources.note: Total_alleles counts distinct alleles in/overlapping a gene, not submissions. P/LP summary excludes overlapping structural variants. File statistics can lag the report date. Not directly comparable to the older D&D dominant subset.

sources.title: MGI human–mouse homology
sources.note: DB Class Key links human HGNC IDs to mouse MGI identifiers. One-to-many homologs are retained.

dnd_dictionary.DISEASE LABEL: Diseases associated with gene (from ClinGen). All genes exhibit autosomal dominant associations, and any auotosomal recessive conditions associated with those same genes are also represented. Because a gene can be associated with more than one disease, genes may show up more than once.
dnd_dictionary.DISEASE ID (MONDO): Disease MONDO ID (another phenotype ontology schema)
dnd_dictionary.MOI: Mode of disease inheritance for associated conditions. AD=Autosomal Dominant, AR=Autosomal Recessive, SD = Semidominant
dnd_dictionary.%HI: Haploinsufficiency % from ClinGen (lower is more likely to be HI, and a cutoff of 10% is typically used)
dnd_dictionary.pLI: Probability of loss of function intolerance, as determined by variant prevalence from gnomAD
dnd_dictionary.LOEUF: Loss-of-function observed/expected upper bound fraction. Metric that pLI is based off of. More biologically interpretable because it represents the ratio of observed/expected variant counts from gnomAD
dnd_dictionary.total_plp: Total number of pathogenic/likely pathogenic variants in the gene (from ClinVar)
dnd_dictionary.missense_plp: Total number of missense pathogenic/likely pathogenic variants in the gene (from ClinVar)
dnd_dictionary.nonsense_plp: Total number of nonsense pathogenic/likely pathogenic variants in the gene (from ClinVar)
dnd_dictionary.s_het: s_het evolutionary constraint value. Lower is less constrained, and values closer to 1 are more constrained.
dnd_dictionary.s_het_lower_CI: lower bound of s_het confidence interval
dnd_dictionary.s_het_upper_CI: upper bound of s_het confidence interval
dnd_dictionary.indel_targetable_pre_NMD_assessment: 0 or 1. 1 = the gene had variants targetable by the indel strategy prior to assessing those variants for whether or not they would induce nonsense mediated decay (NMD) upon indel editing.
dnd_dictionary.num_indel_vars_pre_NMD_assessment: Number of variants that were targetable by the indel strategy prior to filtering them by which ones would cause NMD upon editing
dnd_dictionary.num_indel_amenable_vars_inducing_NMD: Metric of NMD analysis. Represents the number of indel targetable variants that consistently would induce NMD across gene transcripts upon editing
dnd_dictionary.num_indel_amenable_vars_escaping_NMD: Metric of NMD analysis. Represents the number of indel targetable variants that consistently would escape NMD across gene transcripts upon editing
dnd_dictionary.indel_targetable_post_NMD_assessment: 0 or 1. 1 = the gene had variants targetable by the indel strategy AND at least one variant that would induce NMD upon editing
dnd_dictionary.crisproff_targetable: 0 or 1. 1 = the gene had variants targetable by the CRISPRoff strategy
dnd_dictionary.num_crisproff_vars: Number of variants targetable by the CRISPRoff strategy for the gene
dnd_dictionary.base_editable: 0 or 1. 1 = the gene had variants targetable by the base edit strategy
dnd_dictionary.num_base_editable_vars: Number of variants targetable by the base edit strategy for the gene
dnd_dictionary.excision_targetable: 0 or 1. 1 = the gene had variants targetable by the excision strategy
dnd_dictionary.num_excision_vars: Number of variants targetable by the excision strategy for the gene
dnd_dictionary.num_excision_pairs: Number of viable excision pairs that result in excision of one or more gene exons or the entire gene
dnd_dictionary.HPO_term_list: Human phenotype ontology terms associated with the gene
dnd_dictionary.indel_pam_targetable: 0 or 1. 1 = the gene had variants targetable by the indel strategy and had a viable PAM in the vicinity, as determined by EXCAVATE-HT
dnd_dictionary.crisproff_pam_targetable: 0 or 1. 1 = the gene had variants targetable by the crisproff strategy and had a viable PAM in the vicinity, as determined by EXCAVATE-HT
dnd_dictionary.base_edit_pam_targetable: 0 or 1. 1 = the gene had variants targetable by the base edit strategy and had a viable PAM in the vicinity, as determined by EXCAVATE-HT
dnd_dictionary.excision_pam_targetable: 0 or 1. 1 = the gene had variants targetable by the excision strategy and had a viable PAM in the vicinity, as determined by EXCAVATE-HT
dnd_dictionary.hets_across_strats: Number of unique heterozygous individuals from 1000Genomes data that were targetable across editing strategies
dnd_dictionary.prop_hets_across_strats: Proportion of unique heterozygous individuals from 1000Genomes data that were targetable across editing strategies, out of N=2548 people
dnd_dictionary.num_indel_hets: Number of unique heterozygous individuals from 1000Genomes data that were targetable by indel strategy
dnd_dictionary.indel_hets_prop: Proportion of unique heterozygous individuals from 1000Genomes data that were targetable by indel strategy, out of N=2548 people
dnd_dictionary.num_crisproff_hets: Number of unique heterozygous individuals from 1000Genomes data that were targetable by crisproff strategy
dnd_dictionary.crisproff_hets_prop: Proportion of unique heterozygous individuals from 1000Genomes data that were targetable by crisproff strategy, out of N=2548 people
dnd_dictionary.num_base_edit_hets: Number of unique heterozygous individuals from 1000Genomes data that were targetable by base edit strategy
dnd_dictionary.base_edit_hets_prop: Proportion of unique heterozygous individuals from 1000Genomes data that were targetable by base edit strategy, out of N=2548 people
dnd_dictionary.num_excision_hets: Number of unique heterozygous individuals from 1000Genomes data that were targetable by excision strategy
dnd_dictionary.excision_hets_prop: Proportion of unique heterozygous individuals from 1000Genomes data that were targetable by excision strategy, out of N=2548 people
dnd_dictionary.num_hets_targeted_four_guides_indels: Number of heterozygous individuals in 1000Genomes data targetable by the first four optimal gRNAs for the gene, fo rthe indel strategy
dnd_dictionary.num_hets_targeted_four_guides_crisproff: Number of heterozygous individuals in 1000Genomes data targetable by the first four optimal gRNAs for the gene, for the crisproff strategy
dnd_dictionary.num_hets_targeted_four_guides_base_edits: Number of heterozygous individuals in 1000Genomes data targetable by the first four optimal gRNAs for the gene, for the base edit strategy
dnd_dictionary.num_hets_targeted_four_guides_excision: Number of heterozygous individuals in 1000Genomes data targetable by the first four optimal gRNAs for the gene, for the excision strategy
dnd_dictionary.prop_hets_targeted_four_guides_indels: Proportion of heterozygous individuals in 1000Genomes data targetable by the first four optimal gRNAs for the gene, fo rthe indel strategy
dnd_dictionary.prop_hets_targeted_four_guides_crisproff: Proportion  of heterozygous individuals in 1000Genomes data targetable by the first four optimal gRNAs for the gene, for the crisproff strategy
dnd_dictionary.prop_hets_targeted_four_guides_base_edit: Proportion of heterozygous individuals in 1000Genomes data targetable by the first four optimal gRNAs for the gene, for the base edit strategy
dnd_dictionary.prop_hets_targeted_four_guides_excision: Proportion of heterozygous individuals in 1000Genomes data targetable by the first four optimal gRNAs for the gene, for the excision strategy

notes: No single probability of haplosufficiency is calculated.
ClinGen %HI is a percentile rank. Collins pHaplo is a probability of haploinsufficiency.
No evidence (HI=0) is not evidence of haplosufficiency.
Dominant variants are the supplied D&D dominant P/LP subset; all-class dominant counts are unavailable.
Targeting counts describe research eligibility, not validated therapeutic efficacy.
Mouse counts are unique successful statistical rows, not individual animals or human clinical observations.
